title: "Un/Happy For You" makes cable premiere in Cinema One's "Sabay Tayo" lineup
summary: Joshua Garcia and Julia Barretto’s “Un/Happy For You” makes its cable premiere on Cinema One on November 15, headlining the premiere Filipino movie cable channel's “Sabay Tayo” campaign.
